## Samples & the switcheroo {#sec-portfolio-samples}

*This is a recipe for* **dependence**. The independent FFT path assumes units are independent; the sample path couples them with a copula (Iman–Conover) and reads the result back as a sample — the *switcheroo* (`create_from_sample`, `swap_density_df`). Allocation numerics are unchanged because they work off `exeqa`, not raw losses (the switcheroo invariant).
